newsitem.title: UK: BT up on positive press on Iberian deals.
newsitem.headline: BT up on positive press on Iberian deals.

text.p: Shares in British Telecommunications Plc rose on Monday morning amid heavy turnover, after favourable press comment over the weekend, analysts said.
Shares were up six pence at 450p bid by 1208 GMT on volume of nearly 12 million, as BT continued to recover from a 12-week low at 420p on April 3.
"The weekend press comment on the Iberian deals..was positive and the market's been reacting to that," a telecom sector analyst at a European bank said.
Last week saw news of cross alliances between Concert, the group being formed by the merger of BT and MCI Communications, with Portugal Telecom and Telefonica de Espana.
The Sunday Telegraph newspaper said the deals had secured BT a route into Latin America, a market "that is expected to see phenomenal growth over the next few years".
Revenue was expected to grow to $60-65 billion by the millenium from $35-40 billion now, the paper said.
The analyst said the Latin American opening was a key development for BT. "It will provide a very strong growth opportunity," he said.
